John Galsworthy, The Forsyte Saga.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/john-galsworthy/the-forsyte-saga

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- John Galsworthy, the author, died 1933.

First publication of the text used: 1922 (SE colophon: 'The Forsyte Saga was published in 1922 by John Galsworthy.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the edition's rights statement (quoted below) says the text is in the US public domain. The text was first published in 1922, so the 95-year US term from the latest first publication ended by 1 January 2018.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each has a term of life + 70 years or less, so the last person to die (in 1933) puts the text in the public domain there from 1 January 2004 at the latest, whichever country was first, and whether or not two of them published it at once.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
